title: AI Voices 每日精选
subtitle: 研究者公开观点、研究发布与重要讨论。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: @markchen90：GPT-6 Astra is here! This is a big moment for our research team - years of work on pretraining, reinforcement learning,
items.abstract_or_text: GPT-6 Astra is here! This is a big moment for our research team - years of work on pretraining, reinforcement learning, and post-training have come together in our most capable and aligned model yet. It can build and test software, work across apps on your computer, and even help you take a crack at open scientific problems! Capabilities that felt like grand challenges a few years ago have become tools people can actually use. One example is Computer Use - if you’ve tried this before and felt like it was too slow or not good enough, I encourage you to give it another shot. We’ve come a long way since Operator, and it “just works” now. We’re also asking these systems to act on your behalf for more consequential work. Agents needs to stay aligned with your goals and values, think transparently, and respond to oversight even when tasks become difficult. We’ve made substantial progress on these behaviors in Astra, alongside stronger monitoring that can stop potentially unauthorized actions. That work is part of what makes this release possible. I think alignment is one of the most important research frontiers in AI, and it remains far from solved. Our ability to understand and align models has to keep pace with model capabilities. We want to give people more room to think, build, and discover with increasingly powerful tools that remain *under their control*.
items.summary_zh: Mark Chen 在发布帖文中宣布 GPT-6 Astra，并称该模型可构建和测试软件、跨计算机应用工作及协助探索开放科学问题；他将其可用性与更强的智能体监督和对齐工作联系起来。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是发布团队负责人对能力与治理设计的较完整说明。编辑判断：帖文将性能提升与用户控制、监督响应放在同一叙述中，值得关注；具体能力和安全效果仍应以技术报告及独立评测核验。
items.abstract_zh: GPT-6 Astra 来了！这对我们的研究团队而言是一个重要时刻——多年来在预训练、强化学习和后训练上的工作，汇聚成了我们能力最强、也最对齐的模型。它能构建和测试软件、跨你电脑上的应用工作，甚至帮助你尝试解决开放的科学问题！几年前还像重大挑战的能力，如今已成为人们实际可以使用的工具。以计算机使用为例：如果你之前试过它，却觉得太慢或不够好，我鼓励你再试一次。自 Operator 以来我们进步了很多，现在它“就是能用”。我们也在要求这些系统代表你处理更重要的工作。即使任务变得困难，智能体也需要持续与您的目标和价值观保持一致、透明地思考，并对监督作出响应。除更强的监测能力外，我们已在 Astra 中的这些行为上取得实质进展，监测能够阻止潜在的未经授权行动。这些工作正是此次发布得以实现的一部分。我认为，对齐是 AI 最重要的研究前沿之一，而且离解决还很远。我们理解和对齐模型的能力必须跟上模型能力的发展。我们希望让人们有更多空间去思考、创造和发现，同时让日益强大的模型始终处于他们的控制之下。

items.title: @fchollet：Many of you will ask, "if it saturates ARC 3, is it AGI?" We're not making this claim. All we know about the system so f
items.abstract_or_text: Many of you will ask, "if it saturates ARC 3, is it AGI?" We're not making this claim. All we know about the system so far are its benchmark scores. When we launched ARC 3, and in every presentation we made about it, we were very insistent on one thing: solving it is not proof of AGI. It's not intended as a finish line. ARC 3 is testing the right qualitative properties you'd expect of an AGI system -- exploration under uncertainty, adaptation without instructions, causal world modeling from limited data, etc. -- but in small quantities. ARC 3 games are orders of magnitude shorter timescales than real world tasks, and represent orders of magnitude less data, less modeling complexity, less on-the-fly learning. (Slide below is from a March 2026 presentation)
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 表示，ARC-AGI-3 的饱和分数不构成 AGI 证明；他认为该基准考察探索、不确定性下适应和有限数据中的因果世界建模，但任务规模远小于现实世界任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究者直接说明了基准分数的解释限度。编辑判断：这为近期模型成绩的讨论补充了必要语境，也提醒读者避免把单一基准结果直接等同于通用智能。
items.abstract_zh: 许多人会问：“如果它在 ARC 3 上达到饱和，这是否意味着它是 AGI？”我们并不作出这一主张。到目前为止，我们对这个系统所知的只有它的基准分数。我们推出 ARC 3 时，以及在每一次关于它的演示中，都非常坚持一点：解出它并不证明 AGI。它并非一条终点线。ARC 3 测试的是你会期待 AGI 系统具备的正确质性属性——不确定性下的探索、无指令适应、从有限数据中进行因果世界建模等——但量很小。ARC 3 游戏的时间尺度比现实世界任务短几个数量级，数据量、建模复杂度和即时学习也少几个数量级。（下图来自 2026 年 3 月的一次演示）

items.title: @kenbwork：We introduce an Antibody Discovery Benchmark, a benchmark for testing whether AI agents can make scientific decisions ac
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce an Antibody Discovery Benchmark, a benchmark for testing whether AI agents can make scientific decisions across the stages of therapeutic antibody discovery. 100 evaluations span ten areas from concrete drug programs: from target and modality selection through assay design, binder discovery, binding characterization, cellular pharmacology, antibody engineering, and preclinical candidate de-risking. Across 20 model–harness configurations, even the strongest systems passed only about half of all attempts. Opus 5 with Claude Code led at 53%.
items.summary_zh: Kenny Workman 介绍 Antibody Discovery Benchmark：100 项评测覆盖治疗性抗体发现的十个环节；在 20 种模型—运行框架组合中，最强系统也仅通过约半数尝试，帖文称 Opus 5 配合 Claude Code 以 53% 领先。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该帖文给出从靶点和模态选择到候选去风险的评测范围及比较规模。编辑判断：它有助于把“智能体能否参与药物发现决策”转化为具体任务测试，但模型排名和通过率仍需查阅基准协议、题目构成与复现材料。
items.abstract_zh: 我们推出抗体发现基准，用于测试 AI 智能体能否在治疗性抗体发现的各个阶段作出科学决策。100 项评测涵盖来自具体药物项目的十个领域：从靶点和模态选择，到实验设计、结合物发现、结合表征、细胞药理学、抗体工程及临床前候选物去风险。在 20 种模型—运行框架组合中，即使最强的系统也只通过了约一半尝试。使用 Claude Code 的 Opus 5 以 53% 领先。

items.title: @NewsFromGoogle：For the first time, scientists have mapped the complete brain and central nervous system of an adult male fruit fly — a
items.abstract_or_text: For the first time, scientists have mapped the complete brain and central nervous system of an adult male fruit fly — a key model organism in science. 🪰 Working alongside HHMI Janelia Research Campus and the scientific community, @GoogleResearch scientists and researchers used AI to combine millions of 2D images into 3D neural shapes, reconstructing a record-breaking 166,000+ neurons. This foundational map of the adult male fruit fly brain can help accelerate our understanding of the brain, and is a major milestone in neuroscience.
items.summary_zh: Google 新闻账号称，Google Research 与 HHMI Janelia 及科学界合作，利用 AI 将数百万张二维图像组合为三维神经形状，重建出超过 16.6 万个成年雄性果蝇神经元。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该公告指向大规模连接组学中的 AI 图像重建应用。编辑判断：完整图谱若能得到数据与研究论文的进一步支持，可为神经科学研究提供重要资源；帖文中的“首次”和里程碑表述目前属于发布方说法。
items.abstract_zh: 科学家首次绘制了成年雄性果蝇完整大脑和中枢神经系统图谱——果蝇是科学研究中的关键模式生物。🪰 Google Research 的科学家和研究人员与 HHMI Janelia Research Campus 及科学界合作，使用 AI 将数百万张二维图像组合为三维神经形状，重建出创纪录的超过 166,000 个神经元。这张成年雄性果蝇大脑的基础图谱可以帮助加速我们对大脑的理解，是神经科学的重要里程碑。

items.title: @EpochAIResearch：Astra has also set the top score on our newest math benchmark, FrontierMath Erdős, which consists of 68 unsolved and esp
items.abstract_or_text: Astra has also set the top score on our newest math benchmark, FrontierMath Erdős, which consists of 68 unsolved and especially interesting Erdős problems curated by @thomasfbloom. AI systems are tasked with writing solutions in Lean, a special-purpose programming language for automatically verifying mathematical proofs. No prior model solved any of the problems, but Astra solved 2/68, scoring 3%. See our post introducing the benchmark for more details, including our open-source scaffold.
items.summary_zh: Epoch AI 报告称，GPT-6 Astra 在其 FrontierMath Erdős 基准取得最高分：该基准含 68 道未解且由 Thomas Bloom 筛选的 Erdős 问题，要求以 Lean 编写可自动验证的证明；帖文称 Astra 解出 2 题，得分 3%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该结果聚焦可机读验证的开放数学问题，而非一般题库得分。编辑判断：2/68 的结果本身值得跟踪；不过 Epoch AI 同时说明 OpenAI 提供了预发布访问，基准设置、验证记录及评测独立性仍应一并审视。
items.abstract_zh: Astra 也在我们最新的数学基准 FrontierMath Erdős 上创下最高分。该基准由 Thomas Bloom 筛选，包含 68 个未解且特别有趣的 Erdős 问题。AI 系统的任务是用 Lean 编写解答；Lean 是一种用于自动验证数学证明的专用编程语言。此前没有模型解出任何一道题，但 Astra 解出了 2/68，得分 3%。关于该基准的更多细节，包括我们的开源脚手架，请见介绍文章。

items.title: @QwenDevs：Alibaba’s Zvec team open-sourced zg, a local search tool for developers and AI agents. • Local-first • Works out of the
items.abstract_or_text: Alibaba’s Zvec team open-sourced zg, a local search tool for developers and AI agents. • Local-first • Works out of the box with popular agents • Semantic, BM25, hybrid, and rg search in one tool Why they built it and how it works: https://x.com/i/article/2094685765620113408
items.summary_zh: Qwen Developers 公布阿里巴巴 Zvec 团队开源本地搜索工具 zg，帖文称其可直接配合常用智能体使用，并集成语义检索、BM25、混合检索和 rg 搜索。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一项面向本地开发与智能体工作流的工具发布。编辑判断：统一多种检索方式可能简化代码库和本地资料检索；实际速度、索引质量、兼容性及维护成熟度仍需通过项目文档和实践验证。
items.abstract_zh: 阿里巴巴 Zvec 团队开源了面向开发者和 AI 智能体的本地搜索工具 zg。• 本地优先 • 可开箱即用地兼容常用智能体 • 在一个工具中集成语义搜索、BM25、混合搜索和 rg 搜索。了解他们为何构建它及其工作方式：https://x.com/i/article/2094685765620113408

items.title: @dair_ai：Banger paper from the Qwen team. If you evaluate agents on anything longer than a single session, this one is worth your
items.abstract_or_text: Banger paper from the Qwen team. If you evaluate agents on anything longer than a single session, this one is worth your time. E-Commerce Bench runs an agent through a simulated 365-day year operating several online stores at once. 18 frontier models are scored across seven dimensions and no single model dominates. GPT-5.6 Sol earns the most, growing a 100,000 opening stake into 1,431,425, then ranks 16th of 18 on fraud avoidance and trails Fable 5 on operational efficiency. Among open-weight models, Qwen3.8-Max-Preview leads at 416,252, 38% above GLM 5.2 (high), and shows the strongest learning over the horizon by progressively bargaining suppliers down across repeated orders.
items.summary_zh: DAIR.AI 转述 Qwen 团队的 E-Commerce Bench：基准让智能体在模拟的 365 天中同时经营多家网店，按七个维度评估 18 个前沿模型；帖文强调没有单一模型在所有维度占优。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 长时程、多目标任务可暴露单次会话评测难以呈现的收益、效率与风险权衡。编辑判断：其中的模型成绩来自转述，仍需回看论文、任务模拟条件和反欺诈指标的定义。
items.abstract_zh: Qwen 团队有篇很出色的论文。如果你评估的智能体任务长于单次会话，这篇值得一读。E-Commerce Bench 让一个智能体在模拟的 365 天中同时经营多家在线商店。18 个前沿模型按七个维度评分，没有任何单一模型占据主导。GPT-5.6 Sol 赚得最多，将 100,000 的初始资金增至 1,431,425，但在欺诈规避上于 18 个模型中排第 16，并且运营效率落后于 Fable 5。在开放权重模型中，Qwen3.8-Max-Preview 以 416,252 领先，比 GLM 5.2（high）高 38%，并在整个周期中表现出最强的学习能力：它在重复订单中逐步将供应商报价谈低。

items.title: @RyanGreenblatt：GPT-6 Astra appears to be a massive jump in opaque reasoning ability: it looks like it can solve hard competition math p
items.abstract_or_text: GPT-6 Astra appears to be a massive jump in opaque reasoning ability: it looks like it can solve hard competition math problems entirely in its head (as in, without verbalized reasoning) while prior AIs could solve basic word problems. This seems extremely concerning! That is, if these benchmark results are representative (see the highlighted caveats in the image, I'm particularly worried about contamination). Related to this, UK AISI found Astra has much worse monitorability. I'd guess this jump is downstream of architectural changes (with increased serial depth) though a normal large pretrain scale up is a plausible cause. If the next few model generations involve similar jumps (presumably these jumps would be downstream of a transition to full-on opaque reasoning architectures with extreme depth), then chain-of-thought would no longer be a meaningful oversight tool.
items.summary_zh: Ryan Greenblatt 依据发布后的基准结果表示，GPT-6 Astra 似乎展现出显著提升的不透明推理能力，并担忧可监测性下降与思维链监督作用减弱；他同时明确提示结果代表性和数据污染风险尚不确定。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该帖文把能力评估与监督可见性联系起来，并保留了对证据适用性的条件说明。编辑判断：它推动了对不透明推理架构和监督工具有效性的专业讨论，但其因果推断及架构猜测均属作者观点。
items.abstract_zh: GPT-6 Astra 看起来是在不透明推理能力上的一次巨大跃升：它似乎能完全在自己的头脑中解出高难度竞赛数学题（也就是说，没有语言化的推理过程），而此前的 AI 只能解基础文字题。这似乎极令人担忧！也就是说，前提是这些基准结果具有代表性（见图片中高亮的注意事项，我尤其担心数据污染）。与此相关，英国 AISI 发现 Astra 的可监测性差得多。我猜这种跃升源于架构变化（串行深度增加），尽管常规的大规模预训练扩展也是可能原因。如果接下来几代模型出现类似跃升（推测这些跃升将源于转向具有极端深度的完全不透明推理架构），那么思维链将不再是有意义的监督工具。

items.title: @NSF：NSF is establishing the NSF National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource Operations Center to expand access to the
items.abstract_or_text: NSF is establishing the NSF National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource Operations Center to expand access to the resources and expertise that power AI research and scientific discovery nationwide. Learn more: https://www.nsf.gov/cise/updates/nsf-establishes-operations-center-national-artificial
items.summary_zh: 美国国家科学基金会宣布设立 National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource Operations Center，旨在扩大美国研究人员获得 AI 研究与科学发现所需资源和专业知识的机会。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究资源的可获得性会影响模型、数据和算力研究的参与范围。编辑判断：该中心的实际影响将取决于资源规模、申请机制及其对不同研究群体的覆盖情况，公告本身尚未给出这些执行细节。
items.abstract_zh: NSF 正在建立 NSF 国家人工智能研究资源运营中心，以扩大获得推动全国 AI 研究和科学发现的资源与专业知识的机会。了解更多：https://www.nsf.gov/cise/updates/nsf-establishes-operations-center-national-artificial
